entityId.description: Identifier of the entity the transaction is reported for.

legalRegistrationId.description: 9-digit French company identifier (SIREN) associated with the transaction.

transactionDate.description: Date of the B2C transaction (format: YYYY-MM-DD).

transactionDetails.description: Tax breakdown details for the transaction. At least one entry is required.

taxableAmount.description: Taxable amount excluding VAT. Must be greater than or equal to 0 with a maximum of two decimal.

electronicAddress.description: Reception electronic address in Peppol format "scheme:identifier" (e.g. "0225:123456789").

post.description:
Report a B2C transaction for e-reporting purposes.
The transaction is associated with a company identified by its SIREN and
aggregated into an e-reporting period based on the transaction date and VAT regime.

parameters.description: Allowed values: Production, Sandbox. Defaults to Production when not specified.
parameters.name: X-FlowMode

204.description: The B2C transaction has been successfully reported.

400.description: Error 400 : Bad request — invalid or missing fields.

404.description: Error 404 : E-reporting configuration not found for the given company.

429.description: Too many requests. Please try again later.

post.description:
A flow is a single-invoice file, with:
- an XML/PDF file with the data of the invoice
The flow is created with a FlowInfo object, allowing to qualify the flow.
A flow can be:
- an invoice (CII, UBL, Factur-X, JsonInvoice...)
- a lifecycle (CDAR)
- or an e-reporting file

parameters.description: Allowed values: Production, Sandbox. Defaults to Production when not specified.
parameters.name: X-FlowMode

202.description: OK - Response message once the flow has been uploaded.

429.description: Too many requests. Please try again later.

post.description: This allows to validate the JSON invoice before uploading it.

200.description: OK - Response message once the flow has been validated.

429.description: Too many requests. Please try again later.

post.description:
Retrieves a set of flows matching the provided search criteria:   
- When setting flowId, do not specify other criteria   
- Need at least one criterion to be specified   
- Assuming a logical AND when combining criteria   
- Assuming a logical OR for criteria allowing a list of values

Pagination works with pages:   
- In the request, provide the page to be returned   
- In the response, the total count of items

200.description: OK - Response message when returning the results of a search request.   - Holds all the results if code is 200   - Holds partial content if code is 206

206.description: OK - Response message when returning the results of a search request.   - Holds all the results if code is 200   - Holds partial content if code is 206

get.description:
Download a file related to a given flow:
- an invoice
- a life cycle
- an e-reporting

parameters.description:
This parameter allows to provide the type of file to be uploaded, can be either one:
- Original: the document that has been initially sent/provided by the emitter
- Converted: the document that has been optionally converted by the system
- ReadableView: the document that has been optionally generated as the readable file
- Attachment: one of the attached documents, provide the optional index if needed
parameters.name: docType

parameters.description: If docType is an Attachment and in case there are several attached documents, it says which one to address
parameters.name: docIndex

parameters.description: If docType is Converted, it says in which format to convert. By default, it is Json
parameters.name: docFormat
